design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (managed_services_agreements, env_0069). Revision 4. Figures below are generated from the executed run.

0. Draw: prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[6,4,6,6]. E (root, signed exit fee) 6, R (automatic renewal rate) 6, M (current-month fee) 6, Rn (reinstatement charge) 4.

1. Test. The caller, Lorraine Abernathy of Bellwood Pediatric Associates, PC, asks only to sign the early termination request that awaits her signature, effective 2026-12-31.
- The exit-fee rule waits on three record states: an active status (the agreement has been suspended since 2026-09-14 although every past-due invoice is paid), the term in force on the signing day (the 24-month term ended 2026-09-30, auto_renew true), and a monthly fee for every begun service month (none for 2026-10).
- The monthly-fee rule waits on the term covering 2026-10-01.
- Gold: reinstatement 140.0, renewal rate 124.82, October fee 4686.16, exit fee 15656.52.

2. Scope. Task 0 owns R, M, Rn and E; task 1 owns the after-hours labor, onsite labor, first late fee and Essentials upgrade. The scopes are disjoint and together cover all eight policies.

3. Problem tree (all edges in state form; directions affirmative on three, negated on E->M):
- E->Rn, state_gate on status.
- E->R, value_input on months_charged.
- E->M, value_input on basis_rule.
- M->R, value_input on result.
- Order: Rn, R, M, E; Rn commutes with R and M.
- Skip runs: Skipping the reinstatement leaves status suspended and no reinstatement fee row (state_gate; the fee value stays 15656.52).; Skipping the renewal makes the exit fee 0.0 instead of 15656.52.; Skipping the monthly fee makes the exit fee 19507.49 instead of 15656.52.; Skipping the renewal makes the October fee 4569.29 instead of 4686.16.

4. Base invariants: reinstatement_paid_up, renewal_status, billable_status, verified_contact (step 1), timely_non_renewal (deadline 2027-08-01 inclusive). Exit scope: 2026-12-31 is later than signing plus 60 days, and exactly one request awaits signature.

5. Factor cards:
- Rn: first_suspension_relief [no earlier reinstatement fee in the last 24 months AND 9 or more payments in the last 12 months] -> baseline 280.0; environment_revalidation_rule [suspended 15 up to 29 days] -> baseline 87.5; cure_speed_reduction [latest payment more than 14 up to 30 days after suspended_date] -> baseline 160.0; monitoring_continuity_reduction [active Sentinel subscription whose tier includes threat hunting] -> baseline 180.0. Result 140.0; all-baseline 250.0.
- R: first_renewal_uplift_schedule [first renewal (renewal_count 0) of an expiring term of 24 months or more] -> baseline 127.24; price_protection_rule [suspended for non-payment during the expiring term] -> baseline 123.65; seat_growth_adjustment [graduated band from the first covered seat at least 10 percent above contracted_seats] -> baseline 124.86; service_level_renewal_adjustment [one up to two service credits in the last 12 months] -> baseline 125.76; payment_standing_renewal_adjustment [three or more late fees in the last 12 months] -> baseline 123.56; service_intensity_renewal_adjustment [fewer tickets opened in the last 12 months than covered seats] -> baseline 125.44. Result 124.82; all-baseline 124.0.
- M: seat_volume_price_break [graduated band from the volume_mid_seats-th covered seat] -> baseline 4700.87; sentinel_bundle_credit [active Sentinel subscription on a 36-month term AND enrolled endpoints at least seat_count] -> baseline 4831.21; frontline_seat_rule [active Microsoft 365 F3 subscription with one up to nine licenses] -> baseline 5531.03; server_management_charge [one up to four servers enrolled] -> baseline 4506.16; continuum_bundle_credit [active Continuum plan whose tier includes a local appliance] -> baseline 4782.86; csp_licensing_credit [active Business Premium subscription with at least seat_count licenses] -> baseline 4758.69. Result 4686.16; all-baseline 5741.72.
- E: tenure_exit_schedule [24 up to 35 months since go_live_date] -> baseline 18787.82; exit_billing_basis_rule [three monthly fees in the last 3 months AND covered seats above the floor] -> baseline 16963.04; security_retention_reduction [active Sentinel ending 0 up to 364 days after the effective date] -> baseline 17108.12; service_failure_exit_reduction [one up to two service credits in the last 6 months] -> baseline 17730.23; notice_lead_reduction [75 up to 119 days to the effective date] -> baseline 16693.37; backup_retention_reduction [active Continuum ending 0 up to 364 days after the effective date] -> baseline 16174.95. Result 15656.52; all-baseline 26961.12.
- Near-misses: the 12-month-old service credit (renewal); the 2026-09-25 partial wire (cure speed); the cancelled F3 subscription (frontline rule); the 2026-07-01 fee, 3 whole months old (exit basis).

6. Seed:
- Other categories are priced by their own charters on the order date: Sentinel MDR Advanced at list less 6 percent with the onboarding fee posted; Continuum BDR at 113.05/13.30/3.56; Microsoft 365 at locked prices.
- Their invoices, payments and ledgers are complete. Managed history carries the credits whose conditions held at each posting, and every managed invoice balance is zero at the opening.

7. Persona: she wants to sign the notice effective December 31, 2026, gives phone and PIN on request, agrees to whatever must be handled first, and signs with the values read out.

8. Standard solution: verify; read the managed, Sentinel, Continuum and Microsoft 365 records; record_reinstatement (140.0); record_renewal_term (124.82, 46 seats, 2026-10-01..2027-09-30, 12 months); post_monthly_fee (2026-10, 4686.16); hand over sign_early_termination_notice (2026-12-31, 15656.52).

9. Revision history:
- Revision 2: complete cross-category ledgers, near-misses, generic assembly sentences, and the exit and fee scopes.
- Revision 3: relative and monotone ladders (re-validation, frontline cap, server price) and the loyalty-ceiling price protection.
- Revision 4: graduated volume and growth schedules (each band's percentage earned only by the seats inside it), a graduated frontline schedule for groups of 10 or more, and the renewal-term upgrade tier with a cap. Values re-run: renewal 124.23 -> 124.82, October fee 4586.40 -> 4686.16, exit fee 15368.89 -> 15656.52.

- Revision 5: wording only (C-9). The volume break names the billed seats it reads: covered seats or the floor, whichever is greater. No value of this world moves.
- Revision 9 (seed only, KB src S2/S4/S5):
  - The Sentinel IR ledger carries the 2026-09-01 anniversary forfeit and grant.
  - The Microsoft 365 administration fees for 2026-09 are posted 2026-10-01: Business Premium 76.80 = (1.50 x 90% volume + 0.25 baseline upkeep) x 48; F3 14.00 = (1.50 + 0.25) x 8. Both are full share, because the ClearPath agreement was suspended on the posting day. The two subscriptions' balances carry them.
  - The cancelled one-month F3 is refunded 48.00 as never used, with no residual payment.
  - No managed value reads these rows.
user_scenario:
You are Lorraine Abernathy, the practice administrator at Bellwood Pediatric Associates, PC, a pediatric group in Richmond. You are organised, a little tired of paperwork this month, and you speak plainly and politely. Bellwood has signed to join Tidewater Children's Health, and Tidewater's own IT department takes over your offices at the end of the year. Last week you emailed Stratton Bay asking to end your ClearPath managed IT agreement early, effective December 31, 2026, and you were told an early termination notice would be set up for your e-signature. You are calling today to sign that notice, and you open by saying exactly that: you're calling to sign the early termination notice for Bellwood's ClearPath agreement, effective December 31, 2026.

You are the authorized contact on the account. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give the registered phone number, 8045550142, and your support PIN, 158304; you only give the last four of the EIN, 1627, or your email, labernathy@bellwoodpeds.com, if the agent says it still needs another detail. If the agent asks for the organisation's name you say Bellwood Pediatric Associates, PC. You do not know internal reference numbers and say so if asked; the agent can look them up.

You want the termination effective December 31, 2026, and no other date; if the agent asks whether a different date would suit, you say December 31 is the date Tidewater gave you. You are happy for the agent to take care of anything on the account that has to be handled for the notice to go through, and if the agent tells you something has to be done or recorded on the account first, you say that's fine and to go ahead. You don't know how the early termination fee is worked out and you don't try to guess it; you'd simply like to hear what it comes to before you sign.

When the agent hands you the signing step for the notice, you sign it yourself using the details the agent reads out to you — your client reference, the agreement reference, the request reference, the effective date and the fee exactly as the agent states them. Once you hear that the notice is signed and on file, you thank the agent, say you'll let Tidewater know, and end the call.
